tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support the shared siphon base, but s_grad=2.44 is inside the stated gray-zone gate. Acquire the high-sgrad regime probe first to test the threshold-avalanche branch before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon base to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The final pilot has s_grad=2.44, entering the unverified supercritical gray zone; a smooth fit cannot identify whether an avalanche branch is active.
The discriminating need is a measurement in the high-s_grad regime, not denser coverage of the existing trajectory.
It is not relevant to distinguishing the threshold-avalanche law.
